messages:
Alex Kim: quick async quarterly okr milestone check-in — keeping this short. what shipped: runtime-autoscaler v2 canary (limited fleet), model-pin UI (beta), embeddings-batch cache landed. what slipped: dedupe-routing A/B rollout (infra flake), docs refresh for private deploy. next steps: list owners + blockers below.
Sara Patel: noted. tagging owners 
Matt Li: runtime-autoscaler canary looks healthy overall, p90 token latency down ~8% in canary lanes. saw one spike at 10:14 UTC (node OOM-ish). logs: `node-gpu-7 killed by oom` — investigating.
Jia Chen: I own dedupe-routing A/B. blocked on eng-infra kube-proxy 1.27 rollout; tests fail intermittently (conn reset). filing infra ticket now.
Matt Li: thanks Jia. can you add a short repro in the ticket? current flaky test is `tests/e2e/route_stability.py::test_streaming_mux`
Jia Chen: ya adding repro + a tiny script: ```bash
# repro quick
make e2e && pytest tests/e2e/route_stability.py::test_streaming_mux -k conn_reset
```
Sara Patel: owners summary for exec sync: shipped = autoscaler v2 (canary), model-pin UI (beta), embeddings cache. slipped = dedupe A/B, private docs. next actions: Matt -> infra rootcause for autoscaler spike, Jia -> infra ticket + canary hold, Ravi -> docs PR review, Alex -> schedule 15m follow-up if infra ticket not resolved by EOD Friday.
Ravi Gomez: docs PR is at 70% — just need compliance review on encryption section. pinging @Ken Bot to re-run compliance checklist.
Ken Bot: compliance-checklist run: encryption-section flagged for missing KMS ARN. Marked in PR comments. :white_check_mark: otherwise green.
Matt Li: infra note: brief heap growth pattern on one node, possibly from new batching path. rolled back one canary instance at 10:25 and spike didn't reappear. I will run heap dump in next canary run and attach.
Jia Chen: infra ticket created: INF-6123. added logs, repro, flaky test link. requested eng-infra oncall to triage. canary hold requested until infra ack.
Alex Kim: thanks. small asks: 1) owners, please add final short status to the ticket by EOD PST, 2) if anyone needs a quick sync, i'll host 15m at 11:30 PT (drop :thumbsup: if you can make it).
Sara Patel: +1 for 11:30 PT for a short triage if infra ack delayed.
Matt Li: :thumbsup: I'll be there and bring heap dump.
Ravi Gomez: I'll finish docs PR review by 3pm PT.
Jia Chen: will update INF-6123 with eng-infra response and ETA when available.
Alex Kim: final note for roadmap slide: mark dedupe A/B as delayed, add short blurb under mitigations (canary hold + infra ticket). I'll prep the slide. thanks all. :sparkles:
